# World View renderer provenance

The files in `iso/` are reused from the canonical
[`Wonderful-Digital-World/world-view`](https://github.com/Wonderful-Digital-World/world-view)
repository at commit `051d70bf`. That project retains the lineage and visual
language of [tiny.place](https://github.com/localhost/tiny.place).

The renderer is licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later. See the adjacent `LICENSE`
file for the full license. Site-specific projection translation lives outside
this directory in `src/data/world-renderer-adapter.ts`.
